meta.after: Build on an FPGA PCB substrate. Along the left edge place eight interleaved BRAM banks that hold polynomial coefficients under the conflict-free memory mapping scheme. A wide conflict-free crossbar network spans the banks and routes operands to four parallel radix-4 butterfly clusters, each housing a DSP modular multiplier and a modular add/sub ALU. Butterfly outputs pass through a shared modular-reduction unit back to the crossbar. On the right sit the twiddle-factor ROM, the address-generation unit implementing the mapping scheme, a radix-2/4 configuration selector, and a clock PLL. Input and output FIFOs flank the memory banks.
